title: Titanium Hydrogen Flame Arrestor
function: Sintered titanium flame arrestor micro-porous disc
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Hydrogen Flame Arrestor where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Sintered titanium flame arrestor micro-porous disc requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by sintered titanium flame arrestor micro-porous disc and fat life requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for hydrogen hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with SPC sampling
TIG welding all positions with SPC sampling
DPI dye penetrant inspect with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for sintered titanium flame application
commonFailures: Irradiation embrittlement in flux >1e18 n/cm2 - mitigated by fine equiaxed alpha (ASTM 8+) microstructure — critical for sintered titanium flame performance

faq.q: What downhole temperature rating does Titanium Hydrogen Flame Arrestor have?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains >90% of room-temperature tensile and yield strength at 200°C and >80% at 300°C. Titanium Hydrogen Flame Arrestor is suitable for sintered titanium flame in geothermal (HDR/EGS) wells up to 300°C with appropriate consideration of creep in threaded connections. Above 300°C, dedicated creep testing per ASTM E139 is recommended for design life validation.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Hydrogen Flame Arrestor orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Hydrogen Flame Arrestor is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Hydrogen Flame Arrestor?
faq.a: Each Titanium Hydrogen Flame Arrestor shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for sintered titanium flame.
